scenario.note: The overmanned workforce in year 2 is limited to 80% of the overmanned workforce in year 1.
A rule that enforces the overmanned workers in year 2 to be at least 60% of the total overmanned workers across all years.
Two relative limits: workforce in year 1 is at most 75% of workforce in year 3; total short-time workers are at most 25% of total retrained workers.
A rule that limits the sum of short_time workers in year 1 to 25% of the sum in year 3.
Two relative limits: short-time working in year 1 is at least 60% of total short-time working; overmanned workers are at most 50% of total redundancies.
A rule that enforces the short-time working in year 2 to be at least 3 times that of year 1.
A rule bounds the sum of redundant workers in year 1 relative to the sum in year 2.

The scenario sets the required skilled workers in year 3 to 2200, the required unskilled workers in year 2 to 700, and the maximum number of semi-skilled workers that can be recruited each year to 1000.
A rule that limits the sum of redundant workers in year 3 to at most 60% of the sum in year 2.
A rule that enforces the retrain count for skilled to be at least twice that for semi-skilled.
A rule limits the short-time workers at unskilled level to 10% of the total short-time workers.
A rule that limits the sum of redundancies in year 3 to at most 15% of the total redundancies across all years.
The rule ensures that the overmanned workers for semi_skilled skill level are at least 50% of those for unskilled skill level.
A rule that enforces the overmanned workers at the semi_skilled level to be at least 50% of the total overmanned workers across all skill levels.
A rule that limits the sum of redundant workers in year 2 to at most 25% of the sum in year 1.
Rules bound the SUM of a decision measure over a scope; a relative rule compares two such sums.
A relative rule limits the short-time workers at the skilled level to at most 5% of all short-time workers.
A rule limits the proportion of short-time workers at the semi-skilled level relative to all short-time workers.
At least 60% of the total workers recruited must go to year 3.
A rule limits the sum of short_time workers in year 1 to 25% of the sum in years 2 and 3.
